atAGlance: Soda bạc hà is bright mint soda from Vietnam’s playful café menu world, fizzy, green, sweet, and cooling.
whatItIs: Soda bạc hà is soda water with mint syrup and ice. Expect mint soda that is fizzy, sweet, cooling, and bright green on many café menus.
howToEnjoy: Order it when you want a cold, sweet, minty break rather than fruit.
howLocalsOrder: Order soda bạc hà when you want a sweet mint soda. Ask ít ngọt or ít đá before stirring if you want less syrup or less ice.
worthKnowing: At Vietnamese cafés, soda bạc hà is playful: bright green mint syrup, fizz, ice, and cooling sweetness rather than traditional tea.

orderLine.vietnamese: Cho tôi một ly soda bạc hà.
orderLine.english: I’d like one glass of mint soda.
